title: Automated Mining of Hinge-like Protein Modules from AlphaFold PAE: BCR-Parts

contributions.purpose: 从 AlphaFold PAE 自动挖掘可分离蛋白模块
contributions.mechanism: PAE 谱二分(Fiedler 向量+连续性启发)分 k∈{2,3} 块,BCR 块对比打分,置换 p 值 + BH-FDR(每 run 一次)
contributions.domain: 计算结构生物学 / 蛋白模块化
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a PAE-driven segmentation-and-scoring pipeline that produces a calibrated statistic (permutation p-values and BH-FDR across all tested rows)

contributions.purpose: 用独立指标验证 BCR 分数有效性
contributions.mechanism: BCR 分数与独立 PAE 非对称指数做相关
contributions.source_quote: the BCR-derived score correlates with an independent PAE diagnostic, the asymmetry index (Pearson r=0.59, Spearman ρ=0.69)

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现并行实现与证据连接器
contributions.mechanism: 释放脚本输出 CSV/PNG/LaTeX,并映射候选到 PDBFlex/CoDNaS 构象多样性
contributions.evaluation: 报告覆盖度诊断(Table 2);外部验证未完成
contributions.source_quote: We release a reproducible, parallelizable implementation that writes machine-readable artifacts (CSV, PNG, LaTeX tables)

notes: 负结果/局限(诚实):外部实验证据(PDBFlex/CoDNaS)'could not be robustly retrieved in time for this submission',仅报覆盖度诊断,跨数据集验证留待未来—即核心湿实验/构象验证缺席,当前只有内部统计自洽。有编号贡献列表。checklist 全 Yes 并具体(BH-once 协议、48 核分片)。无明显造数红旗,但结论强度受未完成验证限制。
